atomic_facts.fact: DW.com reported on 15 October 2025 that René Benko was sentenced to two years in prison.
The Local.at reported on 15 October 2025 that René Benko was sentenced to two years in prison.
The sentence was imposed by the Innsbruck State Court (the Regional Court of Innsbruck).
The conviction was for bankruptcy fraud (insolvency fraud).
Bluewin.ch reported that René Benko was sentenced to two and a half years in prison.
Yahoo Finance reported that René Benko was sentenced to two and a half years in prison.
Both outlets reported this on 22 September 2026.
